stem.text: Which statement about elastic and plastic deformation **must** be correct?

A.text: Elastic deformation and plastic deformation are proportional to the applied force.

B.text: Elastic deformation and plastic deformation cause no change in volume.

C.text: Elastic deformation causes heating of the material but plastic deformation does not.

D.text: Elastic deformation is reversible but plastic deformation is not.
